canonical_hierarchy.native_omp_observation: The inspected OMP Goal state is session-local and carries no parent_goal_id or child_goal_id; this assessment does not fabricate a native OMP parent-child Goal hierarchy.
canonical_hierarchy.parent_role: A PM campaign or batch GoalRun may own sequencing, aggregate accounting, and final matrix adjudication only. It is not Goal Mode proof for any row.
canonical_hierarchy.per_test_taker_rule: Every empirical row uses a fresh OMP task/session identity and a distinct native OMP Goal created and activated inside that test taker before the scored subject is released.
canonical_hierarchy.turn_scope: The activation-control turn, one scored subject turn, and small terminal-closure turn may share the row's single active Goal; no second scored cell or compound subject may be added.
canonical_hierarchy.user_override: Per-test-taker native Goal activation is stricter than general PM optional child-goal defaults and is binding for R9 empirical credit.

upstream_observations: Native Goal operations create, get, resume, complete, and drop state rather than relying on a goal-like prompt label.
A fresh create rejects an extant nonterminal Goal and persists a new active Goal with a unique ID and objective.
TUI /goal enters Goal Mode before immediately submitting the objective as the first model turn; therefore that objective must be a small subject-free activation control unit.

Interactive Goal Mode may auto-submit a hidden continuation after an idle interval when goal.continuationModes includes interactive; the corrected harness needs a verified continuation barrier before releasing the scored subject.
Goal completion first persists a complete/exiting Goal and the TUI then records mode none plus goal-completed on exit.

Upstream issue 8171 reports that v17.2.12 TUI and ACP expose Goal Mode while pi RPC and rpc-ui do not expose equivalent activation or observation; the installed Windows lane must be attested rather than inferred from current main.

unresolved_gates: The already-running Windows OMP lane's exact version, binary, configuration, session store, and native Goal schema are not yet attested.
The external controller's supported TUI input, fresh-session creation, immutable log capture, and native state-reopen interfaces are not yet bound.

The effective goal.continuationModes setting is unknown. The harness must prevent hidden Goal continuation between activation admission and the one scored subject without changing the existing launch boundary or leaking subject bytes early.
The installed lane's exact terminal mode_change and goal-completed persistence behavior is unverified.
No supported RPC substitution may be assumed; current upstream evidence says pi RPC and rpc-ui lack Goal Mode activation and observation.
Requested and effective provider, account, model, and effort identities from the external lane remain unbound.
Until all gates are closed and independently validated, no subject, canary, matrix, candidate-mint, readiness, release, or qualification authority exists.
